description:
### Findings (verbatim)

### Acceptance
Every quoted finding no longer reproduces. Replace/remove the always-true count comparison; bind any retained assertion to required ordered fsync events. Assert the recorded state_changed_while_interrupted value to pin preservation of authoritative state on the failed call, or remove the unused key if another exact assertion already establishes it. Preserve the existing installed fault injection controls and all child cleanup. Do not add framework tests or unrelated coverage.
